services.desc: Work Of the Day. This is the workout that appears every morning on our blog and on the whiteboard at the gym. It's the workout we are doing in each class, all day long. As Many Rounds As Possible. This is a workout format where we're trying to do as much work as possible in a defined amount of time. Rounds For Time.This is a workout format where we're trying to do a defined amount of work as fast as possible. On The Minute or Every Minute On the Minute. services.name: Drop In
services.desc: At BRIO we love welcoming CrossFitters visiting from other affiliates all around the world! We want to make our gym your home away from home. You must have a current membership at a licensed CrossFit™ affiliate. We only take drop-ins from CF affiliates in good standing that can be found on map.crossfit.com. We do not take drop ins from de-affiliated gyms, gyms that do "CrossFit style programming" but don't pay their affiliate fees, other "functional fitness" or "cross training" style gyms.
